known_limits: This opt-in selector only filters established non-current temporal applicability from already governed admitted/ranked candidates. It does not supply a relevance floor or an answer-level refusal decision.
It intentionally does not rewrite canonical admission or historical recall; current time is supplied by the caller and is not authenticated as current wall-clock time.
There is no source proof that all relevant memories were enumerated and returned, and unknown temporal validity remains unknown.
A new sanctioned post-v7 successor declaration, exact-SHA execution, old/second holdout comparison, frozen original lane replays, privacy, and independent adversarial review are required.

In original Halcyon and Cedarline v1.1 comparisons, v7 recall with the same caller-supplied reference instant returned identical selected contexts. No measured rank-one or coverage gain is attributable to this selector.
The added known_inapplicable_refs are not served-as-current facts and are not a completed answer; the caller must not surface them as current.
